query: I was out walking my golden retriever puppy this morning and he chased a squirrel right into a patch of dandelions, rolling around so much his fur is now bright yellow and I’ve already spent 20 minutes trying to brush it out without any luck. I also just tried the new matcha croissant from the bakery down the street and it was way sweeter than I expected, I think they added way too much honey to the filling. Now I’m trying to figure out why my phone can’t connect to the mobile network at all. I already checked and airplane mode is turned on, my APN settings look like they’re messed up, and I just got a notification the other day that my line might be suspended because I forgot to pay last month’s bill. Could you help me fix this?
